At ASCO 2011, Stein, Carter, Hollaender, Motzer and Sarr presented a model of
the RECORD-1 phase 3 trial of everolimus (Afinitor) in metastatic renal cell
carcinoma that describes all three RECIST lesion types: the sum of target
lesion diameters, the progression of nontarget lesions, and the appearance of
new lesions. The three predictions combine into a progression-free survival
prediction for each patient. The model exists only as a poster
([PDF](https://github.com/iamstein/Publications/blob/main/Posters/Stein11_ASCOposter_RAD_3lesions.pdf)).
This project writes it up as a preprint with a DOI, so it can be cited.

## Documents

- [Working specification](specification.qmd). What the poster holds, the
  choice of server, what the manuscript needs that the poster lacks, and the
  steps to posting.
- [Tumor Models of Nontarget and New Lesions](literature-review.qmd). A
  review of the published models that describe nontarget or new lesions, and
  where the poster sits among them.
- [References](references.qmd). The poster, the trial papers, the companion
  abstracts, and a marker on each recording whether the claim drawn from it
  has been checked.
